chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ibn Isa, from Ya'qub ibn 'Amir, from a man, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) who said:
The rue increases in the intellect.
ai.seo_question: What does the herb Sadaab (Rue) do according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this concise narration from Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him), recorded in al-Kafi, the herb 'sadaab' (rue) is identified as a means to increase 'al-'aql' (intellect or wisdom). This reflects the Shia tradition of linking physical remedies with spiritual and cognitive refinement, suggesting that medicinal plants can serve as catalysts for enhancing the faculty of understanding.
